proposal.finding: ZeroDivisionError in rebalance() when ATR is zero
proposal.evidence: In rebalance(), distance = config.stop_atr * average_true_range(candles, config.atr_period) can be zero if all true ranges are zero. Then most = limits.max_risk_per_trade_pct / 100 * config.margin * equity / distance raises ZeroDivisionError. No check for distance == 0 exists before the division.
proposal.suggested_patch:
Add a guard after computing distance:
```python
if distance <= 0:
    plan.update(status="SKIPPED", reason="ATR is zero; cannot set stop")
    plans.append(plan)
    continue
```

proposal.finding: rebalance divides by ATR distance without checking it is positive, so a flat market (ATR 0) raises ZeroDivisionError after earlier orders in the same run may already have been submitted; main() does not catch that exception.
proposal.evidence: distance = config.stop_atr * average_true_range(...); stop <= 0 is the only guard, so distance == 0 and price > 0 falls through to most = ... equity / distance.
proposal.suggested_patch: Before computing most, if distance <= 0: plan.update(status="SKIPPED", reason="ATR distance is not positive"); plans.append(plan); continue.
